test.reference: union of seq1 and seq2 in ALL positive and negative test rows

search.max_seqs: exact target FASTA sequence count; never top-N
search.exact_matches: No unconditional shortcut; exact matches must satisfy the same reported MMseqs E-value, identity and coverage conditions.
search.decision: nident*10 > alnlen*3 AND reported E-value <1e-5 AND (query_span*2 > qlen OR target_span*2 > tlen); exclude pair iff BOTH training endpoints have a qualifying reference hit.
search.cache: new complete searches, no legacy hit/nonhit decisions reused
search.direct_alignment_required: Both directions use prefilter-mode 2 on ALL selected sequences, unioned with both fixed k=6 passes. No MMseqs coverage prefilter (-c 0); apply coverage OR with strict integer boundaries after alignment.
search.reason_for_direct_alignment: Local reproducible search choice retained to avoid k-mer omissions, not an RF2-PPI published search command. Significant hits only; weak identity/coverage matches cannot trigger exclusion.

sequence_scope: Full source FASTA entries before any training crop; entries can be structure fragments/domains, not claimed canonical UniProt full proteins.
clustering: Use released 70% identity / 70% bidirectional coverage sequence TSVs for BOTH PPI and DDI; bridge namespaces only by exact sequence identity.
deduplication: Exact sequence+contact+mask fingerprint, chain-swap invariant; prefer CongLab canonical, then lexical sample_id. Different supervision maps retained separately.
quality: Reuse release source-specific admission; do not add RF2, pLDDT, PAE or unrelated quality gates.
limitations: This implements the published RF2-PPI identity/E-value/coverage/pair exclusion logic against the fixed E. coli reference. It does not reproduce an unpublished original MMseqs command or claim identical human-filtered membership.
Both-endpoint exclusion permits single-endpoint homology and does not guarantee C3 or complete sequence-disjoint evaluation.
Matches are defined by the locked MMseqs scoring and reported numeric output; no claim of absence of all biological homology.
The frequently evaluated historical E. coli benchmark is not a newly blind test set.
No statement about pretraining exposure or full-protein/structure-level isolation.

legacy_annotation.role: before/after annotation only; no member exemption

authority: User explicitly requested RF2-PPI isolation and rebuilding train.index on 2026-10-24.

paper_rules.sections: M3.1 pp.20-21 (PPI positive/negative); M3.3 p.27 (DDI positive)
paper_rules.pair_exclusion: BOTH endpoints separately have homologs in the reference sequence set; no reference-pair correspondence required

local_implementation_choices.reference: Use the already frozen E. coli test endpoint set instead of the paper human protein set. No validation holdout.
local_implementation_choices.search: Full MMseqs command/version is not published for this filter. This lock pins our explicit implementation, including bidirectional k6/direct passes, database scopes and scoring. E-values are evaluated in each full target database.
local_implementation_choices.coverage: 1-based inclusive aligned span / full source FASTA length; no training crop.
local_implementation_choices.sampling: Existing supplied 70/70 sequence clusters retained per user request; not switched to RF2-PPI 30/80 sampling clusters.
local_implementation_choices.source_quality: No new source-quality filters; this change adopts isolation rules only.

input_revision_review.sequence_scope: Original structure seq1/seq2, not the added full_seq1_id/full_seq2_id columns.
input_revision_review.interpretation: Metadata-only extension for the selected training payload; all selected source hashes and selected sequence/pair mappings agree with the preceding build. Full actual shard checksums are independently verified by the builder.
